description:
Objective: APPLICATION_UNDERWRITER_ASSIGNED template is present and enabled.
Preconditions: Open Application emails with the configured test data.

1. Open Application emails.
2. APPLICATION_UNDERWRITER_ASSIGNED template is present and enabled.
3. Observe the resulting state.
